claim_scope: Independent primary crystallographic determination (Schonfeld, Huang & Moss, Acta Cryst. B 39, 404, 1983; COD 9007660) corroborates that 2H-MoS2 crystallizes in hexagonal space group P 6_3/m m c (No. 194), with a = b = 3.161 Angstrom, c = 12.295 Angstrom, gamma = 120 deg. Scope: 2H polytype ONLY.
